name: Riyuka Bunga
bio: Riyuka Bunga (born Bunga Septiani Rohan on September 29, 1989) is a prominent Indonesian internet celebrity, content creator, stand-up comedian, and actress. She originally rose to viral fame on platforms like TikTok and Instagram for her relatable, humorous rant videos and comedy sketches delivered with a distinctive Betawi dialect. Beyond her digital comedy, she has expanded her career into mainstream acting and environmental activism.
